bullets.text: Starlink Expands Global Reach - **SpaceX** secures $2.6 billion in spectrum licenses as **Starlink** surpasses 8 million customers.
Motorola Edge 70 Launches - The ultra-thin **Motorola Edge 70** debuts in the UK with a sleek 5.99mm profile.
AI Lane Guidance for Cars - **Polestar 4** introduces a new feature to help drivers avoid missing exits.
iOS 26 Enhancements - New features in **iOS 26** include password version history and improved **Apple Podcasts** functionality.
Tesla's Cybercab Production - **Tesla** plans to start production of its autonomous **Cybercab** in April 2026.
Grand Theft Auto VI Delayed - **Rockstar Games** pushes back the launch of **GTA VI** to November 2026.
Meta's AI Video Feed - **Meta** launches its AI-generated video feed, **Vibes**, in Europe.
OpenAI's Revenue Surge - **OpenAI** reports a $20 billion annual run rate and $1.4 trillion in data center commitments.
